units.source_text: 内大臣见过弘徽殿女御之后，乘便到北厅去探望近江君。

en.t: After visiting the Kokiden Consort, the Inner Minister took the opportunity to go to the north wing and look in on Omi no Kimi.

units.source_text: 走到门口，向内一望，但见帘子高卷，近江君正在和一个伶俐的青年侍女五节君打双六。

en.t: When he reached the doorway and looked inside, he saw the blinds rolled high, and Omi no Kimi playing sugoroku with a clever young maid named Gosechi no Kimi.

units.source_text: 她焦灼地揉着手，快嘴快舌地叫喊：“小点子，小点子！”

en.t: She was anxiously rubbing her hands and shouting in her rapid way, "Small numbers, small numbers!"

units.source_text: 内大臣见此模样，想道：“啊呀，不成样子！”

en.t: Seeing her like this, the Inner Minister thought, "Oh dear, how unseemly!"

units.source_text: 便举手制止了先驱的随从人等，独自悄悄地走到边门旁，向门缝里窥探。

en.t: He raised his hand to stop the attendants who had gone ahead, then quietly went alone to a side door and peered through a crack.

units.source_text: 正好纸隔扇开着，可以分明看到室内情状。

en.t: Just then the paper sliding screen was open, so he could see the room clearly.

units.source_text: 但见五节君也尖声尖气地叫道：“还报，还报！”摇着骰子筒，不肯立刻掷出。

en.t: He saw Gosechi no Kimi too crying in a shrill voice, "Pay it back, pay it back!" while shaking the dice cup and refusing to throw it at once.

units.source_text: 内大臣想：“不知道这女子作何感想。”

en.t: The Inner Minister thought, "I wonder what this girl makes of it."

units.source_text: 两人的模样都很轻佻。

en.t: Both of them looked very frivolous.

units.source_text: 近江君面部扁平，然而相貌也很娇美，头发光艳可鉴，足见前世果报不恶。

en.t: Omi no Kimi had a flat face, but she was also quite pretty, and her hair shone like a mirror, showing that her fortune from a former life was not poor.

units.source_text: 只是额角生得太低，声音异常浮躁，这就抵消了其他一切优点。

en.t: Only her hairline was much too low, and her voice was so unusually restless that it canceled out all her other virtues.

units.source_text: 相貌很像父亲，虽然不能分明指出肖似之处，但一望而知其为父女。

en.t: Her looks strongly resembled her father's; though one could not point out the exact features, a glance was enough to know they were father and daughter.

units.source_text: 内大臣对镜自视，也觉得很像，不免自叹宿世孽缘。

en.t: When the Inner Minister looked at himself in a mirror, he too felt the resemblance and could not help lamenting the ill-fated bond from a former life.

units.source_text: 他就走进室内，对近江君说：“你在这里住得惯么？

en.t: He then entered the room and said to Omi no Kimi, "Have you grown used to living here?

units.source_text: 有否不方便之处？我事务烦冗，不能常来看你。”

en.t: Is anything inconvenient? I am burdened with many affairs and cannot come to see you often."

units.source_text: 近江君照例快嘴快舌地答道：“我今住在这里，无忧无虑，心满意足。

en.t: Omi no Kimi answered, rapid-tongued as usual, "Now that I live here, I have no worries and am perfectly content.

units.source_text: 只是回想多年以来，不能会见爹爹，日日思念，夜夜梦想，常是不能见面。

en.t: But when I think back on all those years when I could not meet Father, I longed for you every day and dreamed of you every night, yet still could never see you.

units.source_text: 那时真好比打双六手运不好，气死我也！”

en.t: Back then it was just like having bad luck at sugoroku; it made me furious enough to die!"

units.source_text: 内大臣说：“是啊，我身边不大有可供使唤之人，早就盼望你来，也可慰我寂寞。

en.t: The Inner Minister said, "Yes, I have few people near me whom I can rely on, and I have long hoped you would come and ease my loneliness.

units.source_text: 然而这也不是容易办到的啊。

en.t: But this too was not an easy thing to bring about.

units.source_text: 如果是一个寻常出身的侍者，杂在众人之中，不管其人言行这样或那样，

en.t: If someone were an attendant of ordinary birth, mixed in among everyone else, then whatever that person's words or conduct might be,

units.source_text: 未必入人耳目，惹人注意，倒可放心。

en.t: it might not reach people's ears and eyes or attract notice, so one could actually feel at ease.

units.source_text: 即使这样，也还有顾虑：如果别人知道这是谁家之女，谁人之子，

en.t: Even so, there would still be worries: if others knew whose daughter or whose child the person was,

units.source_text: 则言行设有不端，父母兄弟便失面子，此种事例甚多。

en.t: then any impropriety in word or deed would disgrace the parents and siblings, and there are many such examples.

units.source_text: 何况出身不寻常的人……”说到这里，含糊其辞。

en.t: How much more so for someone of uncommon birth..." At this point he spoke vaguely and left the matter unclear.

units.source_text: 然而近江君不解父亲的苦心，率尔答道：“不打紧，不打紧，我什么都不计较。

en.t: But Omi no Kimi did not understand her father's anxious concern and answered rashly, "It does not matter, it does not matter. I do not mind anything.

units.source_text: 把我看得太重，叫我当小姐，我反而拘束。

en.t: If you treat me too importantly and make me act like a young lady, I only feel constrained.

units.source_text: 我情愿替爹爹倒便壶。”

en.t: I would rather empty Father's chamber pot for him."

units.source_text: 内大臣听了这话，忍不住笑起来，说道：“这种活儿不配你做！

en.t: Hearing this, the Inner Minister could not help laughing and said, "That sort of work is not fit for you!

units.source_text: 你对难得见面的父亲如果有孝心，以后说话时声音稍稍缓和些。

en.t: If you have filial feeling for the father you so rarely see, then from now on soften your voice a little when you speak.

units.source_text: 倘能如此，我的寿命也可延长了。”

en.t: If you can do that, my life may be lengthened too."

units.source_text: 这位大臣善于滑稽，带着笑容说这话。

en.t: This minister was skilled at joking, and he said this with a smile.

units.source_text: 近江君说：“我的舌头是天生成如此的呀！

en.t: Omi no Kimi said, "My tongue was born this way!

units.source_text: 我从小就这样，我那已故的妈妈常常苦苦地叹息着告诉我：

en.t: I have been like this since childhood, and my late mother often told me with bitter sighs:

units.source_text: ‘你出世时，妙法寺那个快嘴快舌的长老走进我产房里来念经，

en.t: When you were born, that fast-talking elder from Myohoji came into my birthing room to chant sutras,

units.source_text: 你便肖似了他。’妈妈很替我担心呢。

en.t: and so you took after him. Mother was very worried about me.

units.source_text: 我总得想个法子改了这毛病才好。”

en.t: I really must think of some way to correct this fault."

units.source_text: 内大臣也很替她担心，但听了这话，觉得她确有一片十分深挚的孝心，

en.t: The Inner Minister was also deeply worried about her, but on hearing this, he felt that she truly had a very sincere filial heart,

units.source_text: 便对她说：“走进产房里来念经的长老，不是个好人。

en.t: and so he said to her, "The elder who came into the birthing room to chant sutras was not a good man.

units.source_text: 他有这毛病，正是前世罪孽的报应。

en.t: His having this fault was precisely the retribution for sins in a former life.

units.source_text: 犹似哑巴和口吃，是毁谤大乘经典的报应。”

en.t: It is like muteness or stuttering, the retribution for slandering the Mahayana scriptures."
